rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The item of 10 May 2024, 12:40, reports that Vladimir Putin met the acting Chairman of the Government ("исполняющим обязанности Председателя Правительства", instrumental), Mikhail Mishustin.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Putin told Mishustin that he had submitted to the State Duma a proposal to appoint him Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation, and hoped the deputies would support it.
